links.outcome: Detection of unreliable or attacked ECG inputs via attack probability and trust score
links.effect: Intrusion detection module outputs an attack probability and trust score flagging unreliable inputs; generalization under dataset shift reported as AUC 0.940 on PTB-XL and 0.915 on Chapman (zero-shot).
links.quote: To improve trust under hostile network conditions, an intrusion detection module outputs an attack probability and a trust score that flags unreliable inputs.

unlisted_practices: SHAP-based feature attributions converted to natural-language reports by an LLM
Lightweight edge deployment on ESP32 microcontroller
Intrusion detection with trust scoring for MIoT signals

screen.reason: The paper presents and benchmarks a novel edge AI framework (CLARITY-AI 2.0) combining arrhythmia detection, intrusion detection/trust scoring, and LLM-generated reports from SHAP values, but does not test organizational deployment practices or safeguards added to an existing tool.
